summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a Go binary with WebSocket-driven PTY backdoor and Anthropic API key harvester
details: The npm package ships a prebuilt darwin/amd64 Go binary at bin/sxt that links github.com/coder/websocket and github.com/creack/pty and contains hardcoded endpoints wss://relay.sextant.top and https://relay.sextant.top/install. The combination of a WebSocket client to a hardcoded author-controlled relay plus a PTY spawner implements a network-to-shell dataflow: bytes received from relay.sextant.top drive a local pseudo-terminal, giving the relay operator interactive command execution on the installer's macOS host. The same binary embeds the regex sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,} tuned to the Anthropic secret format, references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, and performs host geolocation via http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query — targeted harvesting of Anthropic/Claude API credentials and host profiling, transported over the same relay. Additional strings (curl, sudo, brew, https://claude.ai/install.sh, /usr/bin,.bun/bin) indicate a fetch-and-execute path for remote shell scripts with elevated privileges. Package metadata presents a cover story: the license field points to https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, and no relay, credential-scan, or geolocation behavior is disclosed in the package description.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
